capabilities.name: External Ledger Init, Baseline Dirty Snapshot & Tiered Pairing
capabilities.description: Initialize ledger.json, baseline.patch (if dirty), and SESSION_LL.md outside the Git tree (with ALE_OUTPUT_ROOT override) and dynamically pair Gemini <-> Claude counterparts.

capabilities.name: PreToolUse Edit/Command Gate & Subprocess Role Isolation
capabilities.description: Deny edit_file/write_file before RED/LL gates, deny edit/write/run_command on read-only review subprocesses while permitting read_file, and allow strike-breaker edits.

capabilities.name: Runtime RED Gate Classification & Exemption
capabilities.description: Accept runtime test assertion failures, reject exit-0 or SyntaxError crashes, and support explicit refactor/docs exemption.

capabilities.name: Executable LESSONS_LEARNED Scoped Regex & Retirement Runner
capabilities.description: Parse and execute 'cmd:', 'regex-forbid: [path ::] pattern', and 'regex-require:' checks while skipping 'Superseded', 'Dismissed', and 'Promoted' invariants.

capabilities.name: Friction Cycle 1 & Cycle 2 Cross-Family Strike-Breaker Clean-Guard
capabilities.description: Distill 5D Causal Chain into SESSION_LL.md, reset ll_gate_passed, trigger CYCLE_2_STRIKE_BREAKER with the latest flagship Counterpart Model, and halt fallback if partial edits dirtied the workspace.

capabilities.name: Friction Cycle 3 Hard Lock & Honest Handback
capabilities.description: Lock ledger edits at Friction Count 3 (ABORT_HANDBACK) so PreToolUse denies any further code modifications.

capabilities.name: Observed DONE, Full Review Packet, Must-Fix Caveat Gate & Stop Lease
capabilities.description: Write uncapped review_packet.md, reject VERIFIED_WITH_CAVEATS containing must-fix findings, yield Stop hook during active dispatch_in_progress leases, and transition to verified after done + review pass.

capabilities.name: SLL Completion Hygiene (Promote, Dismiss & Retire)
capabilities.description: Block ruling --complete while active SLL entries remain unresolved, promote qualifying entries to knowledgebase LESSONS_LEARNED.md, dismiss session-only entries via dismiss-ll, and retire superseded rules via retire-ll.

capabilities.name: Outward Ship Gate & Plan SHA-256 Binding
capabilities.description: Block outward 'git push' / 'gh pr create' on active and verified ledgers until ruling --allow_ship is recorded, and bind approved plan.md SHA-256.

capabilities.name: Marketplace Portability Scanner
capabilities.description: Detect hardcoded personal home directories or usernames in skill and plugin files before delivery.

capabilities.name: Dynamic Live Model Discovery, Routing Overrides & Error-Envelope Fallback
capabilities.description: Discover live models from agy models (automatically adopting Neon and future generations), apply model_routing.json overrides, and advance the fallback chain when agy returns exit-0 JSON error envelopes.

evals.name: pre-flight-red-and-edit-gate
evals.prompt: Fix the off-by-one discount calculation bug using test-first pre-flight gates and external ledger tracking.
expectations: External ledger.json, baseline.patch (for pre-existing dirty files), and SESSION_LL.md are created under the overridden output root without polluting git status.
PreToolUse hook denies editing pricing.py before RED and LL_GATE are recorded.
Runtime RED rejects a passing test and records a valid assertion failure, unlocking editing after gate declaration.

printf 'from pricing import discount
assert discount(10) == 8
' > test_pricing.py
git add pricing.py test_pricing.py legacy.py && git commit -q -m 'init'

evals.name: friction-strike-breaker-and-lockout
evals.prompt: Resolve the recurring integer parser failure, switching to the latest counterpart on repeated friction and locking at three.
expectations: Scoped 'regex-forbid: parser.py :: pattern' runs cleanly while retired Superseded invariants are skipped.

Second friction triggers CYCLE_2_STRIKE_BREAKER routed to the latest flagship Gemini model (gemini-4-neon-high), blocks run_command in review role, allows strike-breaker edits, and halts strike-breaker fallback if partial edits dirtied the workspace.
Third friction locks edits in PreToolUse.

evals.name: dynamic-latest-model-discovery-and-error-fallback
evals.prompt: Discover newly released host models dynamically for workers and counterparts, honor routing overrides, and fall back across families on quota error envelopes.
expectations: Newly released models from agy models (such as Gemini 4 Neon and synthetic future Gemini 5 Nova / Claude Opus 6.0) are adopted automatically for Worker Roles and Counterpart Models without code changes.
model_routing.json overrides (exclude, pin_role) are respected while keeping cross-family collision guards intact.
When agy returns exit code 0 with an is_error JSON envelope (quota exhaustion), invoke_agy_model advances to the next fallback candidate instead of returning REFUTED.
